reason: As a cautious backer, A gives me what I check before pledging: a line-by-line budget that includes fees, a November 2027 delivery date, and the math showing 572 backers is less than half of the 1,240 sign-ups. Its budget is a bit muddled, though, and it doesn't say most of the 8.1 ratings came from the creator's own convention table. B is more candid about the small ratings sample and has a risks section, but its leftover placeholders, vague budget and missing delivery date make me trust it less.
